name: Iteravis
sum: Ornithuromorph from the Jiufotang Formation at Sihedang, Liaoning, known from several specimens.
holotype: A skeleton (number in Zhou et al. 2014).
material: The holotype and specimens described in 2018.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
